# README.md

Source: https://github.com/atlv24/glizmo/blob/main/README.md

## glizmo

Ever wanted to use bevy_gizmos without needing to touch the ECS to debug some random function?

```toml
[dependencies]
glizmo = "0.1"
```

## Compatibility

| bevy      | glizmo    |
|-----------|-----------|
| 0.17      | 0.1       |

## Example

```rs
use bevy::{color::palettes::css::*, prelude::*};

fn main() {
    App::new()
        .add_plugins((DefaultPlugins, glizmo::GlizmoPlugin))
        .add_systems(Update, draw)
        .run();
}

fn draw() {
    glizmo::sphere(Vec3::splat(10.0), 1.0, PURPLE);
}
```
